Czyżyny (dzielnica 14) — Kraków, Poland

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Grouped with Nowa Huta in the 2022 police breakdown as one of the two safer district pairings citywide (just 2 sexual offences and 404 total thefts combined, among the lowest groupings that year). The 2020 Otodom survey rated it individually at 3.73/5, above the city median. No specific negative incident coverage was found. Sources checked: Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
